title: lua

messages.description: calls the in_<n>_<selector> function for this inlet
load and run a Lua file

arguments.description: Lua code, after the first semicolon

body: [lua] runs Lua code typed directly into the object box, using the pdlua API. The flags set the iolets, and the code starts after the first semicolon; each semicolon becomes a line break. Define functions like in_1_float(self, f) to handle messages per inlet (in_n_<selector> handles every inlet), and dsp/perform to process signals.
